chapter: Leo Watson and the Panassie sessions
title: Leo's character, drinking and clothes
summary: Leo had a good attitude but drank heavily after reaching California, slept in Bunn's house with melting ice cream, and loved dressing well.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What type of person was he?
What type of a person was he?
Leo had the wonderfulest attitude, as far as his self was concerned. His ambition was to make a go of it.
And the thing I know about Leo was that Leo got in touch with some guys out here when he came out here.

And got to drinking heavy. And that's what kept it up -- he kept it up, and he'd go down and bum downtown, and he'd bum. I mean, just -- whenever he got feeling high and wanted to lay down, he'd go lay down, period. Leo -- right in my house -- not here, but in one of the houses I had, Leo used to come to my house and live and go to bed. And he liked ice cream. And he would get him some ice cream and go to bed, and he wouldn't eat it all, and his ice cream would melt, and he'd wake up, and when he did wake up, his ice cream would be all over him.
Huh. He must have been pretty wrecked.

Full of that wine when he went to bed. He got that ice cream and it melted. All night long, he wouldn't pick it up, you know. But he dressed, he liked to dress. Every time he hit a town, he'd go buy himself two or three suits. He had plenty of clothes. And he always looked nice when he went out. Give me a cigarette, son. Chuck, I never heard nobody like that since.
So he came out here with Artie Shaw.
Did you ever hear him with Artie Shaw?
